[[Category:Northwood Cemetery, Logan County, Ohio]]

== Biography ==

The inspected family account records Martha W. Thompson’s marriage to [[Glasgow-589|Moses Thomas Glasgow]] in 1848, after the death of his first wife, [[Pierce-14470|Mary J. Pierce]], on 14 March 1846. It names [[Glasgow-2357|Lois Ladd]], [[Glasgow-2356|Robert Finley]] and infant John Cameron as children of Moses and Mary. Martha was the stepmother of those earlier children. The account records Martha’s death on 1 December 1862, matching the retained profile date.


== Research Notes ==
Martha's surname at birth was Pierce according to FindAGrave. That may be incorrect. Pierce was the last name of Moses Glasgow's first wife.

=== Maternal role review, 26 October 2026 ===

The retrospective family history names Mary J. Pierce as Robert Finley’s mother and Martha as his later stepmother. The complete Robert–Mary profile proposition is assessed at 93% confident within that record scope. Martha’s stepmother role is strongly supported without a numerical biological-maternity estimate. The live WikiTree profile still names Martha as mother with an unmarked certainty flag; the separate live correction remains pending.

The source calls the later wife “Miss Martha W. Thompson”. The older FindAGrave/Pierce uncertainty above remains preserved; the memorial was not newly inspected. The account is an undated six-page typescript attributed to William Melanchthon Glasgow and contains minor date discrepancies. It is not an original birth, marriage or death certificate; those records remain desirable corroboration. No vital fields or Martha’s own parentage are changed.

The same account makes Martha the stepmother of [[Glasgow-2357|Lois Ladd]], another child of Moses and Mary. That stepmother role is strongly supported without a numerical estimate; Lois’s existing Mary maternal attachment is separately assessed at 93% within the retrospective source scope.
